notes.title: Script update
notes.notes:
A small update to the script that should remove more instances of characters being referenced, whilst they were dead.

Hopefully the dead truly stay dead now!

notes.title: Update 2.1.0 - Script and Achievement Fix
notes.notes:
Fixed temporal time space issue with the epilogue where you are married, when you are not.
Fixed several achievements not getting unlocked when completing the game.

notes.title: [Hotfix] Unlocking Achievements
notes.notes:
After receiving reports that achievements we're not getting unlocked, we investigated the issue and found the problem.

You should now be able to once again unlock all achievements! We've made sure that this process is always checked when starting the game.

notes.title: [Hotfix] Magnum Opus
notes.notes:
There were old warnings of a time long gone by, these are now removed and should no longer refer to the incorrect timeline.

The player was warned about Paye no longer being able to create the Magnum Opus, this was incorrect and has been updated to the correct hints.

notes.title: [Hotfix] Bloodfest Achievement
notes.notes: It was impossible to gain the Bloodfest Achievement, this has been fixed and is now available!

notes.title: Major Update: Achievements
notes.notes:
Just before the holiday season, we wanted to surprise you with an update! You can now collect in-game achievements to track your progress.

We've also fixed several minor script and grammatical errors.

Stay safe everyone and happy holidays!

Sugar Rush Studios

notes.title: Minor Update: Pronoun can now be set in Settings
notes.notes: After receiving feedback on the pronoun, this will no longer be if already asked or when it has been set in the Settings. This question will now be asked only once. You can always change your preferred pronoun in the Settings under Gameplay.
